name: trustlayer-ai
description: Open-source, local-first AI security assessment and trust scoring

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @trustlayer/contracts && npm run build -w @trustlayer/risk-engine && npm run build -w @trustlayer/scanner-sdk
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @trustlayer/api && npm run build -w @trustlayer/aig-worker && npm run build -w @trustlayer/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @trustlayer/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @trustlayer/web
